examples.output: I have brought this work unto its completion this day.
I endeavoured, with no inconsiderable trepidation, to procure the necessary provisions from the establishment.

The assembly proved itself to be of a most harmonious character.
I find myself constrained to solicit your esteemed assistance.
The repast proved to be of such exquisite quality as to merit the most fulsome praise.
I feel compelled to venture the opinion that my apprehension differs in no inconsiderable degree.
We are favoured with meteorological conditions of a truly congenial character.
